company.name: BetterCloud
company.shortDescription: BetterCloud is a SaaS Operations leader: Transform employee experience, centralize data protection, and maximize operational efficiency.
company.description: BetterCloud is the market leader for SaaS Operations. With SaaS adoption growing 38% YoY, an average IT team is now responsible for managing and securing 110+ SaaS applications. Existing solutions are not designed to handle aggressive SaaS sprawl. By automating critical work like user lifecycle management and data protection, BetterCloud's 1000's of customers enjoy greater employee productivity and more secure IT environments. With unrivaled SaaS expertise and a powerful integration library, BetterCloud’s SaaS Management Platform typically enables true "Zero Touch" SaaS operations in less than 2 months.

aiResearchSummary.text: BetterCloud is researching methods and systems to manage data objects in a cloud computing environment, focusing on managing activity related to cloud-based software services. Their work involves a platform that oversees data objects processed by software services and the entities initiating processing events, utilizing identifiers to track and centralize operations. This research addresses centralized data protection, operational efficiency, and employee experience in SaaS environments.
